sentences.text:
Bench: Pamidighantam Sri Narasimha, Pankaj Mithal
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal Nos. 2816-2817 Of 2024
 (@ SLP(Crl.) Nos.4399-4400/2024)
 Deepak Kumar Das Etc. Appellant(s)
 Versus
 State Of West Bengal Respondent(s)
ORDER 1. Leave granted.
2. These appeals are against the common order of the High Court in CRM(A) No. 5005 of 2023 and CRM (A) No. 5006 of 2023 dated 06.03.2024.
The High Court had by the said order rejected the anticipatory bail application(s) filed by the appellants.
3. We have by order dated 03.04.2024 granted interim protection to the appellant(s) against arrest.

4. Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and having taken into account that charge-sheet has not been filed till date, we deem it appropriate to confirm our order dated 03.04.2024.
5.

In the event the appellants are arrested in connection with Case No. 913/2023 dated 23.09.2023 under Sections 498A/324/406/34 IPC registered at Kotwali Police Station, Krishnanagar, Nadia,
West Bengal, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Trial Court.
6. Reason: We make it clear that the appellants shall fully cooperate with the investigation.
In case the appellants do not cooperate in the investigation, State is at liberty to move the Trial Court for cancellation of their anticipatory bail.
7. The appeals are allowed accordingly.
